test_name: The breve and the longa as tied semibreves: 2 and 4 semibreve groups, 1 staff space apart
description: Session 25. In repeat mode a breve engraves as 2 semibreve groups (the whole note's 4-copy stencil) and a longa as 4, left to right, 1 staff space apart, with a tie bowing down in each gap; the whole note is unchanged. The head is the Configurator's default (crotchet-minim, solid) at 4 semitones per staff space; the staff space is 1 SVG unit (staff height 4 over lines at positions -4..4). The harvest measures a head by its path's control-point hull, which is wider than the stencil extent LilyPond spaces by; that excess x is read from the quarter q and the half h (two heads overlapping by cnb:multinote-padding -0.5, so h = 2q - 0.5 - x) and taken out once per join: a whole is 4q - 1.5 - 3x, a breve 2 wholes + 1 - x, a longa 4 wholes + 3 - 3x.

assertions.description: Six noteheads: two quarters, a half, a whole, a breve and a longa
The second quarter is one head, the first's width
The half is two overlapping heads, narrower than two quarters
The whole note keeps its width: the 4-copy semibreve, 4q - 1.5 - 3x
The breve is 2 semibreve groups and 1 gap of 1 staff space: 2 wholes + 1 - x
The longa is 4 semibreve groups and 3 gaps of 1 staff space: 4 wholes + 3 - 3x
The breve's groups sit on the whole note's line: same top edge, and the tie bowing down from the centre line moves its vertical centre by under 0.02 staff spaces
The longa's groups sit on the whole note's line: same top edge, vertical centre within 0.02 staff spaces
